notes: The control exposes the shared Codex allowance and purchased-credit balance, not a per-image quote or reservation.
The built-in image interface has not requested paid billing, an API key, an external provider, or an automatic credit purchase.
Official OpenAI documentation says Codex activity counts against applicable plan usage and credits; images and certain tool activity may not appear at chat level.
Complete monetary verification requires the applicable workspace usage or billing records; the campaign therefore reports actual incremental USD as UNKNOWN_NOT_EXPOSED.
